summary: Frontend e2e validation of Sprint Journey Continuity™ + Journey Absorption™ + Full-Width Refactor (iteration 95). All 12 acceptance criteria PASS. Full-bleed Journey environment confirmed (min-h-screen, no max-w-6xl). Journey absorption header renders correctly with project title 'Apartment — Stefano', editorial italian progress narrative ('2 pietre miliari completate · ora Moodboard Direction™'), and advisor strip with 'Seguito da Elizabeth Whitcomb'. Overview tab cleanup verified: 'Sintesi operativa' string COMPLETELY ABSENT from DOM; boxed layout (max-w-6xl mx-auto) returns; StrategicDirectionCard only. Tab routing clean: no ?tab for journey, ?tab=overview etc. dj-shell computed style: border 0px none, border-radius 0px (full-bleed CSS confirmed). JourneyContextHeader™ renders below moodboard editor toolbar showing project name → 'Moodboard Direction™' → 'In lavorazione' pill with working jch-project-link and jch-back-to-journey shortcut. Regression iter94: 10 milestones in dj-rail, click on dj-rail-item-moodboard_direction switches focus, 2 status transition buttons available. No horizontal overflow at 720w viewport. No pageerrors during tab switching. Forbidden lexicon scan: NONE of [task, sprint, kanban, workflow, dashboard, ticket, todo, doing, done, asset uploaded, status updated, entity modified, admin toolbar, module state, tool switch] appears in either project-detail/overview or moodboard editor DOM.
critical_code_review_comments: Hydration warning logged by veng instrumentation: a <span> with x-component='option' is injected inside <select><option>...</option></select> in ProjectDetailPage.jsx line 891 — appears to be tag-instrumentation artifact (x-source-editable=false, data-ve-dynamic=true), NOT a real bug introduced by this iteration. It also exists on prior iterations. Non-blocking but worth flagging to E1 if veng instrumentation is theirs to tune.

ProjectDetailPage.jsx is ~1250 lines — at the threshold of the 700 LOC code-review guideline. Suggest splitting tab components (InspirationsTab/MaterialsTab/ProposalsTab/ConversationsTab/TimelineTab/StrategicDirectionCard) into separate files in a follow-up refactor.

Line 1043: ComposeProposalWizard uses 'market' which is undefined in StrategicDirectionCard scope (should be brief?.market only). Will throw ReferenceError if user clicks 'Componi proposta' when brief.market is undefined. Pre-existing, not introduced by iter 95.
